_comment: Component catalogue for Ford Kuga 2.0 TDCi (DW10C engine, Mk1/Mk2). Part numbers are sourced from parts catalogues and owner-repair records and MUST be verified against the vehicle VIN (e.g. Ford ETIS) before ordering — supersessions and Euro 5/6 variants differ. Coordinates are percentages (x, y) on the component-map drawing: engine-bay view 0-100.

components.name: DPF Differential Pressure Sensor
components.location: Engine bay, mounted beside the air filter housing / near the battery box; two rubber hoses run down to the DPF

components.name: DPF Pressure Hoses (rubber/silicone pair)
components.location: From the pressure sensor down to the DPF pipe unions — check for splits, chafing, soot blockage
app_tests: Live DPF pressure (flat/zero reading = hose fault)

components.name: Fuel Vaporizer (DPF regeneration doser)
components.location: In the exhaust stream upstream of the DPF, under the car

components.name: Diesel Particulate Filter (DPF)
components.location: Exhaust system, under the car, behind the catalytic converter

components.name: PCM / ECM (Powertrain Control Module)
components.location: Engine bay, bulkhead side. Calibration is VIN-specific — replacement units must be programmed to the car

components.name: Battery + Battery Monitoring Sensor (BMS)
components.location: Battery tray; BMS is the small module on the negative terminal. BMS reset required after battery replacement

components.name: Powershift 6DCT450 Mechatronic Unit (TCM + valve body)
components.location: On/in the gearbox, driver side of the engine bay

components.name: AWD DEM (Haldex Control Module) + Pump
components.location: Bolted to the Haldex coupling on the rear differential, under the rear of the car

components.name: Rear Differential / Haldex Oil
components.location: Rear final drive — hypoid gear oil SAE 80W-90F; Haldex clutch oil is a separate fill

components.name: OBD-II Diagnostic Port (16-pin)
components.location: Driver footwell, above the pedals — where the ELM327 adapter plugs in
